FEAT-4-STORY-23.title: Define Provider Detail Response Schema and Contract
FEAT-4-STORY-23.description: Create a standardized provider detail response schema including NPI, name, taxonomy, status, addresses, and external links. Ensure compatibility with existing tool models and downstream consumers.

FEAT-4-STORY-24.title: Integrate Provider Detail Lookup into Evaluate Care Facade
FEAT-4-STORY-24.description: Expose provider detail lookup via EvaluateCare facade and tool router, enabling chat-driven access to provider details using validated inputs and consistent response formatting.

FEAT-4-STORY-25.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Provider Detail Service
FEAT-4-STORY-25.description: Implement unit tests for NPI lookup parsing, external link generation, and error handling, plus integration tests validating end-to-end flow through facade and tool router.
